prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity 1440×900 straight-on desktop web-app screenshot for PulseRank Product Passport
Primary request: Design the “Amethyst Index” Product Passport. Build a luxury editorial interface led by typography, baseline alignment, negative space, and one optical focal object—not a dashboard. The complete left hero bay is devoted to one large, fully visible, uncropped Mega Monster Energy Drink can. The right side is a typographic index with a large mixed-case product title, monumental thin “240 mg”, “caffeine” and “per serving”, then flush-aligned observed facts. Place only one shallow glossy ultraviolet/amethyst glass lens behind and slightly under the active “240 mg” measurement. Integrate “Compare” and “Open source” as a restrained editorial utility rail rather than detached cards. The compact bottom footer is one continuous region divided into exactly four columns, in this order: “Product metadata”, “Observed facts”, “Source record”, “Ranking eligibility”.
Input images: Images 1–4 are style, material, lighting, and typography references only; use their shallow focus, directional blur, translucent glass, crisp focal hierarchy, oversized editorial numerals, and premium spacing without copying crypto content or composition. Image 5 is only a product silhouette and immutable-content reference for the Monster can; it is a visual anti-reference, so discard its steel, framing, typography, and composition.
Scene/backdrop: dark-only charcoal-black lacquer instrument space; generous negative space; no light theme.
Style/medium: realistic shippable premium web UI, not concept art, device mockup, poster, or component demo. Typography is the star: wide premium neo-grotesk, thin/regular monumental numeral, mixed case, subtle italic descriptors, generous tracking, crisp tabular figures, precise baseline alignment. Never use industrial condensed, stencil, or monospaced type.
Composition/framing: 1440×900 landscape, straight-on screenshot. The full product-image bay occupies the entire left hero. The right editorial index is primarily open typography and separators, not containers. The single amethyst lens stays shallow and localized beneath the active caffeine measurement. Keep the exact four-column footer compact and fully visible.
Color palette: charcoal lacquer, near-black, cool white, muted gray, and rare ultraviolet/amethyst glass only.
Materials/textures: subtle lacquer depth, one shallow glossy amethyst lens, hairline separators, crisp type; no steel.
Text (verbatim where rendered): “PulseRank”, “Mega Monster Energy Drink”, “240 mg”, “caffeine”, “per serving”, “709 ml serving”, “33.9 mg / 100 ml”, “320 kcal”, “81 g sugar”, “Compare”, “Open source”, “Product metadata”, “Observed facts”, “Source record”, “Ranking eligibility”, “Caffeine Informer”, “Observed 22 Aug 2026”, “Eligible for caffeine ranking”, “Eligible for sugar ranking”.
Component mapping: Express only familiar interaction affordances equivalent to shadcn Tabs, Badge, Separator, Button, and Tooltip; Magic UI Blur Fade and Number Ticker; Aceternity Card Spotlight. Restyle them into one coherent editorial surface so the screenshot never resembles a component demo. Depict no animation frame that blurs facts.
Motion intent: the single glass lens may respond to pointer with subtle lighting only; all facts remain stationary; reduced motion is fully static.
Constraints: All specified text and facts must remain crisp, readable, and immutable. Product understanding cannot depend on image, color, or motion. Preserve the supplied can silhouette and appearance. Do not add facts, measurements, scores, targets, charts, progress, ranks, source claims, ingredients, medical or health guidance, recommendations, or products. No Trust Score. No watermark.
Avoid: generic dashboard, card-grid dashboard, bento grid, repeated rounded cards, many containers, charts, progress bars, score rings, olive, yellow, green cast, blurry text, giant amorphous gradient blobs, excessive glow, more than one glass lens, fake health recommendations, invented facts, steel, screws, scanlines, crypto terminology, APY, TVL, deposit, withdraw, industrial condensed typography, stencil typography, monospaced typography, all-caps everywhere.
